title: timmbobb's Stair Chairs
body:
This datapack allows you to create chairs that you can sit on in vanilla Minecraft! All you have to do is name a stair or half slab of any type to "Chair" without the quotes in an anvil and you can place it and sit in it!

![An image of minecraft character sitting on a stair block on a throne](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd5679424e234e2f0983319d0e8b3d57c84e1e46.jpeg)
